description: Who can supply this, ranked by evidence, not by money: the companies that won public contracts in the category (CPV divisions; UNSPSC mapped), buyers that came back, recent wins, contracts near the budget and - with for_company - how many companies like the buyer bought from each. Say the need in words (need="core banking integration team, 10-30 engineers") or pass a category (a slug such as it-services, or a CPV / UNSPSC code); country= keeps suppliers that won there or run an office there that hires. Each supplier: fit, why, two contracts that prove it (dated, linked), its typical contract size and whether it sits near budget_usd, the check, and reach (contact_company). Free. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

budget_usd.description: The budget: suppliers whose typical contract is far from it rank lower.

category.description: A category slug (it-services, software, construction-work, business-services...) or a CPV / UNSPSC code; read before need.

country.description: ISO code of the country the work is for.

for_company.description: The buyer (domain or name): suppliers that companies like it bought from rank higher.

name: find_suppliers
title: Find suppliers with evidence
